verdict.rationale: React's docs say that on the server it can start streaming HTML while data is still being fetched, progressively filling in content before any JavaScript loads. The GitHub README confirms server rendering on Node, and hydrateRoot attaches interactivity to HTML generated by react-dom/server. The docs also steer full apps toward frameworks like Next.js, so the streaming SSR setup is often framework-mediated. Missing for 10: API-level docs for the streaming server renderer, explicit evidence that selective or progressive hydration speeds up interactivity, independent or hands-on corroboration.
